title: Alleles, genotype and phenotype

match.reason: The closest bank point, Genotype and phenotype, covers the genotype and phenotype definitions and the role of environment, but it does not teach that a dominant allele masks a recessive one, which the new point requires, and the dominance card covers dominance without the genotype and phenotype definitions, so no single bank point matches the brief.

draft.title: Alleles, genotype and phenotype
card: a version of a gene. An organism has two alleles for each gene, one from each parent.
the pair of alleles an organism has, written as letters such as TT, Tt or tt.
the trait that can be seen or measured, such as tall or short.

A dominant allele (capital letter) shows when it is present. A recessive allele (small letter) shows only when both alleles are recessive. So TT and Tt both give the dominant trait, and only tt gives the recessive trait.
draft.remember: Genotype is the alleles you carry. Phenotype is the trait you show.

a.q: A pea plant has the genotype Tt, where T (tall) is dominant to t (short). What is its phenotype?
opts: Short, because t is the second allele
Medium height, because it has both alleles
Tall, because it has two copies of T
a.why: The dominant allele T masks the recessive allele t, so the plant is tall. A medium height is wrong because one allele masks the other here, and the plant has only one T, not two.
a.clue: Which allele shows when both are present?

b.q: In guinea pigs, black fur (B) is dominant to white fur (b). Zoe has a white guinea pig and a black guinea pig. Which statement must be true?
opts: The white one has the genotype bb
The black one has the genotype BB
The white one has the genotype Bb
The black one has the genotype Bb
b.why: White is the recessive trait, so it shows only when both alleles are recessive: bb. The black one could be BB or Bb, because both genotypes give the same phenotype, so neither can be named from its fur alone.
b.clue: Which trait needs two recessive alleles to show?

b.best: The white one has the genotype bb
